reason: A DSH interface plugin that provides a keyboard-accessible command palette for finding and executing sessions, workspaces, views, host commands, and skills.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供可通过快捷键唤起的命令面板，用于搜索并执行会话、工作区、视图、主机命令和技能。
summaries.en: Adds a keyboard-accessible command palette to the DSH web interface for searching and executing sessions, workspaces, views, host commands, and skills.

capabilities: Provides a searchable command palette in the DSH web interface
Executes registered host commands and user-callable skills
Supports keyboard shortcuts and configurable panel settings
Displays command status, retry controls, and cancellation for long-running tasks
